reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004036B0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/004036B0-GOPlayer.cpp at sha256 cb1b03e34a2db1a4eb04131dc9bb689310d7cb3a65e67020b09954e01c0b7fa4 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOPlayer(int32_t param_1, float param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: GOPlayer
retail_function.summary: Single block 0x4036B0-0x40374F: g_bc2380+=1; type-word store to g_bc2358[g_bc2380*0x564]; store 1 to g_bc2384[g_bc2380*0x159]; Sys_ResolveSymbol_23(name,0,&g_bc2364[...],0x20); memcpy([E+4],{1,0,0x3FF00000,&g_script_ret_type},0x18); return 1.

candidate_function.summary: Single block 0x4036B0-0x40374F: g_bc2380+=1; type-word store to g_bc2358[g_bc2380*0x564]; store 1 to g_bc2384[g_bc2380*0x159]; Sys_ResolveSymbol_23(name,0,&g_bc2364[...],0x20); memcpy([E+4],{1,0,0x3FF00000,&g_script_ret_type},0x18); return 1.

divergences: Frame pointer read from [E+8] instead of [E+0xc].
Missing call to 0x00417090 (Level_InitTextures_7); its return constant is hard-coded.
Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 receives the argc word instead of the script frame.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004036B0 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/go/004036B0-GOPlayer.cpp (sha256 cb1b03e34a2db1a4eb04131dc9bb689310d7cb3a65e67020b09954e01c0b7fa4). Single block 0x4036B0-0x40374F: g_bc2380+=1; type-word store to g_bc2358[g_bc2380*0x564]; store 1 to g_bc2384[g_bc2380*0x159]; Sys_ResolveSymbol_23(name,0,&g_bc2364[...],0x20); memcpy([E+4],{1,0,0x3FF00000,&g_script_ret_type},0x18); return 1.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail reads the name pointer from [E+0xc] (the QVM frame slot) and the result buffer from [E+4]; BN models it as (int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc). The candidate declares int32_t GOPlayer(int32_t param_1, float param_2): param_2 is the normal cdecl [E+8] argc slot, not [E+0xc], so the name pointer would be read from the wrong stack word at the QVM call site.The retail frame slot is [E+0xc] (BN already models it as arg2/arg3 with an explicit @ 0xc offset). The candidate declaration puts its second (or third) parameter at [E+8], the registered argc slot, so the same source compiled into the QVM call site would read the wrong stack word.

The candidate declaration puts its second (or third) parameter at [E+8], the registered argc slot, so the same source compiled into the QVM call site would read the wrong stack word.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) at 0x004036B0; radare2 recovers the identical 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 5 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail calls 0x00417090 (Level_InitTextures_7: mov eax,1; ret) and 0x004B8A80 Sys_ResolveSymbol_23(name,0,&g_bc2364[...],0x20). The candidate omits the 0x00417090 call entirely (it keeps the constant 1 that the call returns) and passes the argc slot as the name pointer.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Profile stride 0x564 and 0x159; 0x18-byte return record {1,0,0x3FF00000,&g_script_ret_type}; resolve size 0x20; globals 0x00BC2380/0x00BC2358/0x00BC2384.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Result record written to [E+4] (correct for arg1); g_bc2384 index and g_bc2358 store correct; the name pointer is read from [E+8] instead of [E+0xc].

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Returns 1 on the only path (EAX=1 after the memcpy), matching retail's mov eax,1 path.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: No floating-point arithmetic in the block; the record contains the 0x3FF00000 bit pattern as data.
checks.rationale: No floating-point arithmetic in the block; the record contains the 0x3FF00000 bit pattern as data.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc)" at 0x004036B0; radare2 recovers "fcn.004036b0 (int32_t arg_34h, int32_t arg_30h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004036B0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t GOPlayer(int32_t param_1, float param_2);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate source is a decompiler transcription and its declared 2-argument cdecl signature does not preserve the QVM 3-word call frame.
